title: Calendars
intro: Each session of the next eight weeks becomes an event in the participants' calendars, with the video link. It works both ways: what changes here follows there, a session moved or deleted in the calendar is moved or skipped here, and the participants' answers become their attendance.

accountHint: Invitations are sent by the organizer of this account.

removed: Coming events removed from the calendars.
